definitions.gloss: love and hate; mixed feelings of love and hatred
definitions.explanation: The coexistence or interplay of love and hatred, often directed at the same person or thing. Used in literary and emotional contexts.

examples.japanese: {愛憎|あいぞう}が{入|い}り{混|ま}じる。
{父|ちち}に{対|たい}する{愛憎|あいぞう}の{念|ねん}を{抱|いだ}いていた。
examples.english: I harbored feelings of both love and hatred toward my father.

examples.japanese: この{小説|しょうせつ}は{親子|おやこ}の{愛憎|あいぞう}{劇|げき}を{描|えが}いている。
examples.english: This novel depicts a drama of love and hate between parent and child.

notes:
USAGE:
A literary word that captures the complex coexistence of love and hate. Often used in descriptions of family relationships, romantic relationships, or intense emotional dramas. Common in literary criticism and emotional narratives.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {愛憎|あいぞう}{劇|げき} (drama of love and hate)
- {愛憎|あいぞう}が{入|い}り{混|ま}じる (love and hate are intertwined)
- {愛憎|あいぞう}の{念|ねん} (feelings of love and hate)
- {愛憎|あいぞう}{半|なか}ば (half love, half hate)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {愛|あい}: love — only the positive emotion
- {憎|にく}しみ: hatred — only the negative emotion
